d.why: On screen in five season 4 Framework episodes (4x17-4x20, 4x22) as Mack's daughter.
On screen in three season 4 episodes (4x02, 4x05 and the 4x06 Momentum Labs flashbacks) as a Momentum Labs ghost.

Seen alive only in 2x01 'Shadows' (2x02 shows just his corpse), where he is a mercenary on Hartley's team helping the Obelisk mission before dying in the crash; he is the subordinate of Hartley and Coulson, not their boss or family.
On screen in seven season 6 episodes as one of Sarge's crew.
Only in 2x07 'The Writing on the Wall', but she is the murder victim whose killing by Sebastian Derik opens the case the episode is about.
On screen in two season 1 episodes: Lorelei enthralls him at the motel in the 1x14 'T.A.H.I.T.I.' tag and casts him aside at the biker bar in 1x15 'Yes Men'.
Only in 3x03 'A Wanted (Inhu)man', where he is Lincoln's old friend who hides him, calls the hotline and dies of a heart attack, a helper in Lincoln's story with no family or boss tie.
On screen in two season 7 episodes ('A Trout in the Milk', 'Adapt or Die') as the Chronicom posing as Mack's father.

Only in 2x06 'A Fractured House', where he debates Senator Ward and leads Walters into Scarlotti's ambush, an accomplice to Scarlotti rather than the episode's main villain, with no family or boss tie to a filed character.
On screen in three season 1 episodes ('Providence', 'Ragtag', 'Beginning of the End') as Garrett's HYDRA pilot.
Only in 2x13 'One of Us', but she is one of the episode's villains, a member of Zabo's revenge crew who takes command and is defeated by Bobbi.
On screen in two season 6 episodes ('Code Yellow', 'The Sign') as an employee at Deke's company.
On screen in the last three season 7 episodes as a soldier in Malick's crew.
Only in 1x22 'Beginning of the End' (1x21 just mentions him), where he is a coerced Cybertek handler whom Skye bluffs with a fake bomb; he works under Garrett and his wife has no file.
On screen in two season 7 episodes ('After, Before', 'Stolen') as Jiaying's Afterlife second-in-command.
On screen in two season 7 episodes ('A Trout in the Milk', 'Adapt or Die') as the Chronicom posing as Mack's mother.
On screen in two season 6 episodes ('Code Yellow', 'The Sign') as one of Deke's staff.
Only in 1x13 'T.R.A.C.K.S.', but he is the episode's direct antagonist, the contact who sells the team out, tortures May and is killed by her.
On screen in three season 3 episodes (3x11, 3x12, 3x17) as Ramon's Inhuman enforcer, later in Hive's thrall.
On screen in six season 3 episodes as Rosalind Price's ATCU agent.
Only in 2x06 'A Fractured House', but he is the episode's villain, leading the attack on the UN in S.H.I.E.L.D. gear and the safe-house ambush until May beats him.

Only in 1x07 'The Hub', where she is a local boss whose men hold Fitz and Ward until Fitz fixes her power and she gets them across the border, a helper in their mission with no tie to a filed character.
On screen in two season 5 episodes ('Fun & Games', 'Together or Not at All') as Faulnak's Kree hunter.
Only in 4x03 'Uprising', where he is a party magician the Watchdogs mistake for an Inhuman until Yo-Yo saves him, a bystander in her subplot.
Only in 1x05 'Girl in the Flower Dress', but the episode turns on his selling data to Raina, and he is Skye (Daisy Johnson)'s boyfriend.
Only on screen in 6x07 'Toldja' (mentioned in 6x03), where he is the villain of the Fitz-Simmons story, sentencing them to the deadly blade game and rigging it once Izel pays.
On screen in four season 4 episodes (4x01, 4x06-4x08) as a S.H.I.E.L.D. lab agent.
Only on screen in 7x03 'Alien Commies from the Future!', but he is the episode's villain, the Chronicom who powers up Helius and fights Coulson and Sousa.

Only in 'The Totally Excellent Adventures of Mack and the D', where she is the Deke Squad's demolitions expert who plants the bomb on a Sibyl robot; Deke and Mack are her bosses, and her love for Roxy Glass is a one-sided declaration, not a partnership.
On screen in five season 2 episodes as a member of Gonzales's council.
